children: Jackson elected Donald C. Templin to its Board of Directors and appointed him to the Audit and Compensation Committees, effective October 12, 2026.
Director; Member, Audit Committee; Member, Compensation Committee
To fill vacancy from Gregory Durant’s earlier resignation
Fills vacancy relating to Gregory Durant’s resignation

Former EVP & CFO of Voya Financial; senior finance roles at Marathon Petroleum; former PwC partner; BA in Accounting, Grove City College; served as independent director on three public company boards (audit committee member on two)
Appointed to Audit Committee and Compensation Committee; qualifies as audit committee financial expert and as independent director under NYSE standards
Annual cash retainer $125,000; annual equity grant $185,000; prorated for partial year; additional cash if committee chair; indemnification agreement effective October 12, 2026
